animations.name: Scroll reveal (fade + slide up)
animations.impl: CSS transition on [data-animate] (opacity 0, translateY(20px)) toggled to .in-view by IntersectionObserver (threshold .15, unobserve after first hit); re-queried on router.asPath
animations.duration: 0.6s (but only 0.2s transform-only on elements that also have .tilt, because .tilt's transition overrides it - opacity then snaps)
animations.cost: low runtime; 'transition: all' is broad. Risk: content (incl. hero h1, 34 elements on home) is opacity:0 in SSR HTML until JS hydrates -> delays LCP and hides content if JS fails; elements mounted after the effect runs are never observed

animations.name: 3D tilt on hover
animations.impl: JS mousemove on every [data-tilt] (17 on home + every product/category card) -> getBoundingClientRect() + inline style.transform rotateX/rotateY up to 6deg; mouseleave resets
animations.cost: medium: un-throttled mousemove handler with a layout read per event; no perspective set so rotation looks like a flat squash and .layer translateZ(18px)/preserve-3d do nothing; inline transform permanently overrides Tailwind hover:scale-105 (brand cards) and .product-card:hover translateY(-4px) lift once the pointer has moved; also runs on touch-less hover devices only

animations.name: Floating blurred circles
animations.impl: CSS @keyframes float translateY 0 -> -12px, infinite, on two absolutely-positioned blur-lg/blur-xl circles in the hero
animations.cost: low (transform only) but two permanently running animations on filtered layers; barely visible (white/blue-300 at 10% over photo)

animations.name: Parallax bands
animations.cost: high on desktop Chrome: fixed backgrounds are repainted on every scroll frame (not composited); iOS ignores it anyway

animations.name: Header glass -> solid
animations.impl: scroll listener (rAF-throttled, not passive) toggles nav-glass/nav-solid at scrollY>40; Tailwind transition-colors duration-300
animations.cost: low JS; backdrop-filter blur(12px) on a sticky header costs paint on every scroll frame over images

animations.name: Back-to-top fade
animations.impl: opacity transition toggled by .show at scrollY>500; click -> window.scrollTo smooth
animations.cost: low; z-index auto so it sits under the cart FAB at the same bottom-right position on catalog pages

animations.name: Products dropdown
animations.impl: Tailwind 'transition duration-200' opacity 0<->100 on hover; -translate-y-1/translate-y-0 are no-ops (TW2 needs the 'transform' class)

animations.name: Header search widen
animations.impl: transition-all duration-200, md:w-44 -> md:w-64 on focus (nav links hidden via md:hidden at same time)
animations.cost: low; animates width (layout) and the nav disappears abruptly

animations.name: Hover lifts
animations.file: styles/globals.css:335-338 (.cart-fab), 521-524 (.cart-submit), 536-539 (.product-card); styles/account.css:40-43 (.ui-btn--primary), 415-418 (a.record-card); pages/index.js:189 (hero CTA), 322 (brand hover:scale-105), pages/products/index.js:46
animations.impl: CSS transition on transform (+ box-shadow on product-card, cart-fab, record-card, .tilt)
animations.cost: low-medium: box-shadow transitions repaint; lifts overridden by tilt inline transform on cards

animations.name: Brand logo grayscale -> colour + zoom
animations.impl: CSS transition on filter + transform of img inside .brand-card:hover

animations.name: Cart drawer slide + overlay fade
animations.impl: transform translateX(100%) -> 0 (.open) and overlay opacity (.active); overlay backdrop-filter blur(2px)
animations.cost: low (compositor); not mirrored in RTL (always slides from the right)

animations.name: FAQ open/close
animations.impl: toggles 'hidden'/'block' with a 'transition' class that cannot animate display
